conditions.name: Futuristic Visionary
conditions.summary: New technology and tales of scientific marvels have you inventing furiously.
conditions.resolution: Before rolling a Build Equipment action for something that would help Enigmas or Science actions, resolve this Condition to gain 8-again on the roll. If it succeeds, gain a Willpower point.

conditions.name: Radiation Poisoning
conditions.summary: Exposure to atomic radiation has poisoned you. It's a poison whose Toxicity depends on how bad and how long the exposure was, doing its damage once a scene, or the grave Poisoned Tilt in action scenes. Without supernatural healing your damage takes twice as long to heal, and Mental actions take −2. The Storyteller may make it temporary, ending after a scene of medical treatment and a full chapter.
conditions.resolution: Significant, ongoing medical treatment, and either a full story passes, or a full chapter passes and you raise your Stamina.
conditions.beat: Your wound penalty increases, or you fall unconscious from this Condition's damage.

tilts.name: Iteru's Black Blood
tilts.summary: Foul ichor covers the ground. Anyone with open wounds has the moderate Poisoned Tilt for the scene, and swallowing it brings the grave one. Failing a breaking point roll near it brings the Madness Condition. Humans who touch it gain Gluttonous as a second Vice for the rest of the story.
tilts.cause: The rotting flesh of Crocodile seeps into the waters, and stains Iteru's banks when they fall.
tilts.ending: When Iteru's waters next rise and carry it away.
